name: Woolworths
scale_as_of: not stated (page checked 2026-11-04; WHL reports on a 52-week comparable period)
evidence: Woolworths Holdings' own home page reports group turnover and concession sales of R84.5bn, split 69% Food, 27% Apparel, Beauty and Home and 4% Financial Services.
note_append: R84.5bn is recorded as group turnover and concession sales exactly as stated, and is never used as group revenue. Its 35541-employee figure covers the Woolworths division only and is kept separate from the group measure.

name: Deloitte
note_append: The legal name was corrected to Deloitte and the former value Deloitte & Touche was retained as an alias, because the record now carries the partnership name that Deloitte itself uses in South Africa and the old value would otherwise be lost.

aliases: Deloitte & Touche;Deloitte South Africa;Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu
